h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Sambhal

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Sambhal

items.pText: A school or colony in Sambhal that orders playground equipment from us usually wants to know one thing first: how does it reach a town this size, and who puts it up? FunPlay Systems builds every piece at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,170 km away. It travels by road to your site, and our installation team or a dealer in north India fixes it in place.

Sambhal sits in the western Uttar Pradesh plains, between Moradabad and Badaun, and is known for its horn and bone handicrafts. Summers here are very hot and winters bring fog and cold mornings, so we suggest galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic for most sites. Send us the size of your ground, the age of the children and a few photos. We will reply with suggested equipment and a layout drawing that marks the safe play area.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: What to arrange before installation day in Sambhal

c: A little preparation on your side saves a lot of time once the truck arrives. Clear and level the area marked on our layout drawing, and remove stones, roots and building waste. Keep a covered, lockable room near the site where the packed equipment can be stored for a day or two.

items.q: Do you install playground equipment in a smaller town like Sambhal?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road anywhere in India. Installation in Sambhal is done by our own team or by a dealer in north India who works with us.

items.q: What materials do we need to keep ready for grouting?
items.a: Usually cement, sand, aggregate and water near the site. We confirm the exact list and who supplies it when we share the layout drawing and quote.

items.q: How long is the warranty on swings and slides?
items.a: The warranty is three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when our installation and maintenance instructions are followed.
